description: Source code for Grove LCD RGB driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for LCD control and RGB backlight management.

methods.name: glcd_print
methods.description: Prints a string to the LCD display.

methods.name: glcd_cursor_pos_set
methods.description: Sets the cursor position on the LCD.

methods.name: glcd_display_state_set
methods.description: Sets the display state (on/off, cursor, blinking).

methods.name: glcd_input_state_set
methods.description: Sets the input mode of the LCD.

methods.name: glcd_color_select
methods.description: Selects a color for the backlight.

methods.name: glcd_function_get
methods.description: Gets the current LCD function mode.

methods.name: glcd_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the LCD and RGB backlight.
